Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -49.27% and leveraged. SPAL, also leveraged and new, is down -36.54%. SMH is flagged for TRIM at -10.47%. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields for any further upward movement. Also, watch for any signs of stabilization or further weakness in the broader chip sector.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions amidst macro headwinds.
plays: Consider cutting SOXL given its deep -49.27% loss and leveraged decay, especially on margin.
Review SPAL's -36.54% loss; its leveraged nature amplifies risk on margin.
SMH is down -10.47% and flagged for TRIM; respect its 540 stop to manage chip exposure.
